title: Bunk's playful and teasing side
summary: Blumberg describes how Bunk gave people a hard time for fun and left arguments hanging.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: But I do want to say about this episode in the bar that this was a typical example of a kind of playful mood that Bonk would get into with people. He would... He had a very devilish side to his personality when he would, just for the heck of it, he'd start giving somebody a hard time with kind of tongue in cheek. Yeah. But yet he'd make you feel awful uncomfortable for a minute, you know, because you didn't know how to take or how to handle the situation, you know.

Well, you mentioned the other night too that things aren't a typical of Bunky, that maybe argue all night along about some little point that didn't amount to anything, some little funny argument. Yeah. Just for the fun of it.

And then maybe when it was all over... He'd say the opposite. He'd just make one statement and walk away and leave it hanging in the air. Yeah. And you'd realize you'd made a fool out of yourself the whole time. He'd be all twisted up, yeah. He didn't know now whether he was kidding the whole time. He didn't know what to think. Yeah.
